name: nexus_get_mod_changelogs
description:
Get the changelog history for one mod [v1 - uses v1 REST quota]. Returns: JSON dict mapping version -> list of HTML changelog strings, e.g. {"1.1": ["

Fixed X

"], "1.2": ["

Added Y

"]}.

domain_name.description: Nexus Mods game domain (lowercase URL slug), e.g. 'forzahorizon6', 'skyrimse'. NOT the display name.
domain_name.title: Domain Name
